system.description:
Pick Lock (Action): Prerequisite: Nimble Hands: Roguecraft[1]. You must have a Lockpick Kit equipped in both hands to use this ability. You attempt to pick a lock. A simple lock has a DC14 Check DC. An Advanced Lock has a DC19 Check DC. A Master’s Lock has a DC24 Check DC. Each lock comes with a Level. You must succeed at this check a number of times equal to the Lock level to open it. After opening it, you may close the lock again to lock it once more.

1 Item Slot · 500gc · Locks and Keys, rulebook p.204
